propositions: The macOS py3.13 CI cell intermittently kills the pytest-xdist worker on test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer due to per-test timeout exceeding 300s under CPU contention
The test compares 884 renderable units by spawning ~1768 serial pandoc processes in a single monolithic test function, measuring 91.6s idle and 504.8s under saturation (1.7x over the 300s budget)
The --timeout-method=thread mechanism calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, killing the worker process without traceback or assertion text rather than failing the test cleanly
The osprey sharing commit 48a3ba0b8a does not cover this test file and its cross-worker artifact does not provide the per-unit oracle pairs required for this equivalence comparison
The fix chunks the test into fixed-size batches (size 40) parametrized by index, reducing per-test cost to ~4.2s idle with 13x headroom and enabling work distribution across xdist workers
A coverage guard test asserts that all chunks reassemble to 884 total units while keeping _EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE at 1 and comparing every unit with real pandoc on both sides
